summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 8 October 2026 under UK Listing Rule 6.4.9R. The disclosure states that independent non-executive director Chris Vogelzang was appointed to the Supervisory Board of Adyen N.V., effective 7 October 2026, following shareholder approval at Adyen's Extraordinary General Meeting. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. This is a routine director-declaration filing for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No deal or risk-arb angle exists; watch only for future directorate changes.
